title.narrative: Neighbourhood Energy Investment Fund (NEIF) in Ukraine

description.narrative: To promote commercial investments in sustainable energy through mobilising private capital, technologies and know-how.

UAF will be an instrument to facilitate private sector investments in Ukraine on commercial basis in a high-risk business environment, while Ukraine is still a country at war. UAF is intended to showcase private investments aimed at rebuilding and modernizing Ukraine in sectors that are critical to the rebuilding of Ukraine and to the stabilisation of the Ukrainian economy. Examples of focus sectors are green energy and infrastructure, agricultural products, financial services, digital services/IT, utilities, healthcare, etc. The objective of this facility is to address and contribute to the needs for stabilising the Ukrainian economy and in rebuilding the country by spurring new impact investments and private sector co-investments.
